title: Only 15% Of Adults Can Pass This Dentist Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Teeth and Tissues, Growing and Supporting, Oral Health Basics, Structures and Function, Dental Connections across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Know the science behind a smile?
Test what lies beneath.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Teeth and Tissues, Growing and Supporting, Oral Health Basics, Structures and Function, Dental Connections. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a real dental-school entrance examination, professional qualification or source of personal dental advice.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.
